content.therapy_section: Chronic therapy and management of bradycardia attributable to atrioventricular block and bundle branch block are discussed, highlighting the importance of guidelines from ACCF/AHA regarding heart failure management. Various studies on temporary cardiac pacing, technology, effectiveness, and safety are reviewed.
content.chronic_therapy: Heart failure guidelines from ACCF/AHA are emphasized in managing bradycardia related to atrioventricular block.
content.general_principles: The section discusses observation strategies for degrees of atrioventricular block.
content.prehospital_care: Guidelines and practices for prehospital cardiac care using transcutaneous pacing are mentioned, including advantages in emergency scenarios.
